name: rentemester-accounting-draft-workflow-v9
sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounting_draft_events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  draft_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(draft_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
  version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version >= 1),
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN ('created','revised','submitted','rejected','approved_posted')),
  payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_hash) = 64),
  canonical_payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(canonical_payload) BETWEEN 2 AND 262144),
  reason TEXT,
  journal_entry_id INTEGER REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  actor_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  actor_program TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor_program)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  previous_hash TEXT,
  event_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(event_hash) = 64),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK((event_type = 'rejected' AND length(trim(reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000) OR (event_type != 'rejected' AND reason IS NULL)),
  CHECK((event_type = 'approved_posted' AND journal_entry_id IS NOT NULL) OR (event_type != 'approved_posted' AND journal_entry_id IS NULL))
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_accounting_draft_events_draft ON accounting_draft_events(draft_id,id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_accounting_draft_one_post ON accounting_draft_events(draft_id) WHERE event_type = 'approved_posted';
CREATE TRIGGER accounting_draft_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON accounting_draft_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'accounting draft events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER accounting_draft_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON accounting_draft_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'accounting draft events are append-only'); END;
